title: Not locker gold. Tuesday gold.
caption:
Every Indian house has one rule about gold. The good gold lives in the locker and comes out for weddings.

These never went in. A braided rope of gold tone strands, about 25mm across, no stones. Woven Gold Hoops, ₹1,299, our most-ordered piece.

They pair with the Brushed Gold Huggies, ₹999. Take 2 pieces for 10% off or 3 for 20% off. Your bag applies the code, BUY2 or BUY3, by itself.

Today's mangal: Marathi, मंगळ.

[ woven gold hoops · 18k gold tone plated · not locker gold ]
first_comment: What is in your mother's locker? We will not tell. #NairaFlore #HoopEarrings #EverydayJewellery #DemiFineJewellery #NairaPetite
alt_text: Slide 1: a drawn sage-green steel almirah stands on a deep red floor against a lilac wall, with a maroon suitcase on top and a small steel lock plate on its right door. Its door mirror holds a photo of a woman's ear wearing a braided gold-tone hoop. Text: House rule 02, the locker. The good gold lives in the locker. Not locker gold. Tuesday gold. On the floor, the NAIRA and MANGAL seal with the Marathi word मंगळ and a small steel key.

Slide 2: the same sage-green almirah, closer, with the maroon suitcase on top. Its left door, the mirror, is shut; its right door, the locker, is swung right back. Inside the locker, a red velvet box sits on a steel shelf and a bundle of envelopes tied with string on the shelf below. A handwritten locker list is taped inside the open door: wedding set, worn 3 times since 1998; nani's kangan, weddings only; one coin every dhanteras; FD papers, do not touch; naphthalene, for reasons. Outside the locker, the real pair of braided hoops hangs from a steel hook on the mirror, with a note in the same hand taped under them: tuesday gold, worn this morning. On the floor: Woven Gold Hoops, 1,299 rupees. 18K gold tone plated. Headline: The locker list. Everything in it waits for a wedding. The hoops don't.

Slide 3: on ivory, a photograph of the braided hoops, one hanging against a plaster block and its pair resting on top. Beside it: 25mm. No stones. One pair. Braided rope of gold tone strands, about 25mm across. Woven Gold Hoops, 1,299 rupees. 18K gold tone plated. For every tuesday the locker doesn't open. At the foot, the NAIRA and MANGAL seal with मंगळ and a small steel key.
